description: Validates and prices a stay, checks current availability without holding a room, and emails a six-digit code. It prices and validates the stay, so no separate quote is needed first. Requires the property, room type, dates, guest name, email and contact phone. If the guest already gave a name, email or phone in this chat, use them and ask only for what is missing. The intent and code last 15 minutes. An identical start while its intent remains open returns the same booking_id without another email; that booking_id can resend the code. A start with any changed detail replaces the earlier unproved intent at the same property. No stored contact stays are read before verification; the phone affects no pre-verification limit. Each normalized email can receive at most three booking codes per hour and six per rolling 24 hours across the portfolio. Configurable portfolio hourly and rolling daily ceilings and a property hourly ceiling apply; booking codes pause if the hub counter cannot confirm both budgets within two seconds. Reaching a ceiling returns the requested stay link and property phone. The resend mode takes only booking_id; at most two resends are allowed, at least 60 seconds apart. A room is held only after email-code verification succeeds. If chat booking is switched off, returns the prefilled reserve.html link. High Country Motel in Bellevue accepts single or double room requests, up to 30 nights, with a starting-rate estimate and staff confirmation required. For High Country, ask about pets and put the explicit answer on its own notes line as Pets: Yes or Pets: No; service animals are not pets. Pet deposits are outside the estimated room total.

booking_id.description: Opaque identifier returned by the first step.

email.description: Email address for the verification code.

guests.description: Guest count, subject to the room limit.

notes.description: Optional plain-text arrival details or requests.

phone.description: Contact phone number, with country code for international numbers.

property.description: Property name, slug, domain or unique short name.

roomtype.description: Room type: single, double or studio; case-insensitive.
